description: This file defines utility search algorithms, including standard binary search and a ring-aware binary search, within the Orleans.Runtime.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: SearchAlgorithms
classes.description: Contains static methods implementing various binary search algorithms, including standard and ring-based binary search.

methods.name: BinarySearch
methods.description: Performs a generic binary search over a range of indices, using a comparer function to locate the target element.

methods.name: RingRangeBinarySearch
methods.description: Conducts a binary search over a collection of ranges (like a hash ring), accounting for wrap-around, to find an element with a specific key.
